## 2. Replacement policy on unseen tools

Tools that reach the limit within the recorded runs: 15 (1 cases never reached it and are left out of this test).

| Policy | Tools | Failures | Safe life used |
|---|---|---|---|
| Risk-based, p* = 0.2 | 15 | 2 | 65% |
| Fixed K (shortest safe life of the other tools) | 15 | 1 | 45% |

Illustrative cost per tool (failure = 20, unused safe run = 1): risk-based 5.00, fixed 5.33. These cost weights are assumptions, not data.
